# New renderings chosen in iliad-069 (Iliad 11.544–654)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἐν … ὦρσε (Ζεὺς … Αἴανθ’ … ἐν φόβον ὦρσε, 11.544) | "in Ajax fear stirred up" | "stirred up fear in Ajax" | "put to flight", "struck with fear" (each decides the force); ὄρνυμι "stir up", with the preverb ἐν in tmesis |
| τρέσσε (11.546) · τρεῖ (11.554) | "he trembled" · "he trembles" | "he flinched" · "he flinches" | "fled", "ran" (the verb covers both, and each scene is a slow backing away); follows the table’s τρεῖν (5.256) "to tremble" / "to flinch" |
| ἐφ’ ὁμίλου παπτήνας (11.546) | "glancing about at the throng" | "glancing about at the throng" | "looking over the crowd", "peering round"; παπταίνω "glance about" as in the table’s παπταίνοντε |
| ἐντροπαλιζόμενος ὀλίγον γόνυ γουνὸς ἀμείβων (11.547) | "turning back again and again, a little, knee for knee changing" | "turning to look back again and again as he moved a little at a time, one knee passing the other" | "step by step", "stumbling"; ἐντροπαλίζομαι keeps "turning back again and again" (6.496), ὀλίγον "a little", γόνυ γουνὸς ἀμείβων the image of one knee passing the other |
| αἴθων (λέων, 11.548) | "fire-bright" | "fire-bright" | "tawny", "ruddy" (each decides the colour); follows the table’s αἴθων "fire-bright" (horses, iron, cauldrons), extended to a lion |
| μέσσαυλος (βοῶν ἀπὸ μεσσαύλοιο, 11.548) | "the cattle’s farmyard" | "the cattle’s farmyard" | "fold", "byre", "stable" (each picks one structure); the yard in the middle of a farmstead |
| ἐσσεύαντο (11.549, aorist of a simile) | "have driven off" | "drive … away" | "chased", "scared away" (each decides the force); σεύω "drive, chase", the aorist read as the aorist of similes and put in the present in `i` |
| πῖαρ (βοῶν ἐκ πῖαρ ἑλέσθαι, 11.550) | "the fat" | "the fat" | "the best", "the fattest", "a fine animal" (each guesses what is meant); πῖαρ is "fat" |
| ἐγρήσσοντες (11.551) | "keeping awake" | "keeping awake" | "watching" (reserved for φυλάσσω), "on guard"; ἐγρήσσω "be awake", as in the table’s ἐγρήσσοντα (20.53) "awake" |
| κρειῶν ἐρατίζων (11.551) | "for flesh longing" | "longing for flesh" | "meat", "the meat of the cattle"; κρέας "flesh", as in the table’s ἀνδρόμεα κρέα, and "longing for" for ἐρατίζω with the genitive |
| ἰθύει (11.552) | "charges straight on" | "charges straight on" | "rushes", "attacks" (kept for ἀΐσσω and ἐπαΐσσω); ἰθύς "straight" |
| οὔ τι πρήσσει (11.552) | "accomplishes nothing" | "accomplishes nothing" | "does no good", "gets nowhere"; follows the table’s πρήσσω "accomplish" / "make headway" |
| θαμέες ἄκοντες (11.552) | "close-set javelins" | "close-set javelins" | "thick", "many", "frequent" (θαμέες in the table is "set close together"); ἄκων "javelin" |
| δεταί (καιόμεναί τε δεταί, 11.554) | "burning torches" | "burning torches" | "firebrands", "brands", "faggots"; a rare word, taken as "torches" from the burning and from the lion’s fear, and the note says so |
| ἀπὸ νόσφιν (ἠῶθεν δ’ ἀπὸ νόσφιν ἔβη, 11.555) | "away, apart" | "away" | "far off", "to one side"; ἀπό is the adverb, νόσφιν "apart" as in the table |
| τετιημένος ἦτορ · τετιηότι θυμῷ (11.556, 11.555) | "grieved in heart" · "with grieved heart" | "grieved at heart" · "grieved at heart" | "sad", "downcast"; follows the table’s τετιημένος ἦτορ "grieved in the heart" and the shipped "grieved" |
| περὶ γὰρ δίε νηυσίν (11.557) | "for exceedingly he feared for the ships" | "for he was terribly afraid for the ships" | "worried for", "was anxious"; περί the adverb "exceedingly", δίε "feared" |
| νωθής (ὄνος … νωθής, 11.559) | "sluggish" | "sluggish" | "stubborn", "dull", "slow-witted" (each picks one side of the word); the note gives the sense |
| ἐβιήσατο παῖδας (11.558) | "has overpowered boys" | "gets the better of boys" | "beaten", "defeated", "forced"; βιάομαι "overpower" |
| ῥόπαλ’ ἀμφὶς ἐάγῃ (11.559) | "many clubs round about are broken" | "many clubs are broken round him on every side" | "worn out", "split"; ἄγνυμι "break", ῥόπαλον "club" (9.319) |
| βαθὺ λήϊον (11.560) | "the deep standing crop" | "the deep standing crop" | "tall corn", "thick wheat", "the ripe grain" (each decides the crop); λήϊον "standing crop" as in the table’s πολυλήϊος and ἀλήϊος |
| κείρει (λήϊον, 11.560) | "crops" | "crops" | "mows", "reaps", "shears", "grazes"; κείρω "cut" in the sense of cropping |
| βίη … νηπίη (11.561) | "childish is their strength" | "their strength is a child’s" | "foolish" (the table keeps νήπιος for folly), "weak", "feeble"; follows the table’s νηπιάχοις "childish" |
| σπουδῇ τ’ ἐξήλασσαν (11.562) | "with difficulty they drove him out" | "only with difficulty do they drive him out" | "in haste", "quickly" (the other sense of σπουδή); follows the table’s σπουδῇ "with difficulty" (2.99, 5.893) |
| φορβή (ἐπεί τ’ ἐκορέσσατο φορβῆς, 11.562) | "fodder" | "fodder" | "food", "pasture"; the word is "food" and for a beast "fodder" |
| πολυηγερέες (ἐπίκουροι, 11.564) | "many-gathered" | "gathered in great numbers" | "assembled from far", "numerous", "gathered from many places" (the formation does not decide between them); πολύς + ἀγείρω "gather", and the note says so |
| ξυστοῖσι (11.565) | "with polished spears" | "with polished spears" | "with lances", "with smooth spears"; follows the table’s ξυστῷ "polished" spear |
| νύσσοντες … μέσον σάκος (11.565) | "stabbing … the shield in the middle" | "stabbing the middle of his shield" | "striking", "pricking", "thrusting at"; νύσσω "stab" |
| ἕποντο (Αἴαντα … Τρῶες … ἕποντο, 11.565) | "always followed" | "always followed" | "pursued", "pressed on"; ἕπομαι "follow", kept apart from ἕπω "be busy about" (11.474, 11.483 in the table) |
| Τελαμώνιον υἱόν (Αἴαντα μέγαν Τελαμώνιον υἱόν, 11.563, 11.591) | "great Telamonian son" | "Telamon’s great son" | "Ajax son of Telamon", "the Telamonian"; the adjective Τελαμώνιος "Telamonian" is kept (the table’s Τελαμώνιος Αἴας), with υἱός in the phrase |
| μνησάσκετο θούριδος ἀλκῆς (11.566) | "would be mindful of impetuous might" | "would remember impetuous might" | "would call to mind his fury", "would think of battle"; follows the table’s θούριδος ἀλκῆς "impetuous might"; μιμνήσκομαι with the genitive "be mindful of" |
| ἐρητύσασκε φάλαγγας (11.567) | "would restrain the battle-lines" | "would check the battle-lines" | "would hold back" (kept for ἀνέεργε φάλαγγας, 3.77), "would stop the phalanxes"; ἐρητύω "restrain" (1.192) |
| τρωπάσκετο φεύγειν (11.568) | "would turn to flee" | "would turn and flee" | "would turn tail", "would run"; τρωπάω "turn" repeated, as in the table’s ἀποτρωπάω |
| ὁτὲ δέ (11.568) | "at another time" | "at other times" | "then again", "and sometimes"; the pair ἄλλοτε μέν … ὁτὲ δέ is "at one time … at another" |
| προέεργε … ὁδεύειν (11.569) | "kept barring from marching" | "kept them from advancing" | "held back" (kept for ἀνέεργε), "turned away"; προείργω "bar", ὁδεύω "march" |
| θῦνε μεσηγὺ ἱστάμενος (11.570–571) | "he rushed, taking his stand" | "rushed … taking his stand there" | "charged to and fro" (adds a motion), "stood firm" (drops θῦνε); θύνω "rush" as in the table |
| πάγεν ὄρμενα (11.572) | "stuck, speeding forward" | "stuck … as they sped forward" | "were fixed", "darting" (kept for ἀΐσσω); πήγνυμι "fix, stick" and the participle of ὄρνυμι |
| πάρος χρόα λευκὸν ἐπαυρεῖν (11.573) | "before the white flesh to touch" | "before they could touch his white flesh" | "taste", "have the benefit" (the table’s ἐπαύρωνται, 1.410, is about benefit and does not fit a spear); ἐπαυρεῖν "touch, get at" |
| λιλαιόμενα χροὸς ἆσαι (11.574) | "longing to glut themselves with flesh" | "longing to glut themselves on it" | "eager to feast", "thirsting for blood"; ἆσαι "glut" as in the table’s ἆσαι Ἄρηα (5.289) |
| Φαυσιάδην (11.578) | "Phausius’-son" | "son of Phausius" | "Phausiades"; the patronymic as the table’s Ἀτρεΐδης "Atreus’-son" / "son of Atreus" |
| ἧπαρ ὑπὸ πραπίδων (11.579) | "in the liver beneath the midriff" | "in the liver under the midriff" | "the heart", "the wits" (πραπίδες is "wits" at 1.608 and 7.92 in the table; here the body part), "lungs"; follows the table’s φρένες "midriff" for the body part (9.301) |
| εἶθαρ δ’ ὑπὸ γούνατ’ ἔλυσεν (11.579) | "and at once he loosed his knees" | "and at once loosed his knees" | "killed", "brought low" (the idiom is kept whole, as in the table’s γούνατ’ ἔλυσεν, 5.176); εἶθαρ "at once" |
| αἴνυτο τεύχε’ (11.580) | "was taking the armour" | "began to strip the armour" | "took", "seized"; the imperfect αἴνυτο "was taking", with τεύχεα "armour" (2.808) |
| ἀπαινύμενον (τεύχε’ ἀπαινύμενον Ἀπισάονος, 11.582) | "stripping the armour from" | "stripping the armour from" | "robbing", "taking from"; ἀπαίνυμαι "strip, take from" with the genitive of the man |
| δόναξ (ἐκλάσθη δὲ δόναξ, 11.584) | "the reed" | "the shaft" | "the arrow" (ὀϊστός is the arrow in the line before), "the cane"; δόναξ "reed", the arrow’s shaft |
| ἐβάρυνε (11.584) | "it weighed … down" | "it weighed … down" | "the wound weighed", "the arrow weighed" (each supplies a subject the Greek leaves out) |
| ἔθνος ἑταίρων / ἑτάρων (11.585, 11.595) | "the company of his companions" | "the company of his companions" | "the band of companions" (the table’s ἔθνος ἑταίρων, 7.115); the shipped iliad-016 wording of the same line 3.32 is kept for 11.585, and 11.595 follows it inside this part |
| ἀμύνετε νηλεὲς ἦμαρ Αἴανθ’ (11.588) | "ward off the pitiless day from Ajax" | "ward the pitiless day off Ajax" | "defend Ajax from his doom", "save Ajax from ruin" (each turns the day into a general ruin); ἀμύνω "ward off" (1.341), νηλεές "pitiless" (8.525) |
| ἐλελιχθέντες (στῆτ’ ἐλελιχθέντες, 11.588) | "whirled round" | "wheel round" | "rallying", "turning about" (ἐλελίζω keeps "whirl round", the table’s ἐλελίχθησαν 5.497); the aorist passive participle |
| βιάζεται (11.589; βιαζόμενον, 11.576) | "is pressed hard" | "is hard pressed" | "is overwhelmed", "is forced"; βιάζομαι "press hard" |
| ἄντην (ἀλλὰ μάλ’ ἄντην ἵστασθ’, 11.590) | "right in front" | "right in front" | "face to face" (reserved for ἀντίον), "head-on"; ἄντην "right in front" with μάλα |
| βεβλημένος (11.592, 11.612, 11.650) | "struck" | "wounded" | "hit" (kept for βάλλω of a missile, 3.368), "pierced"; the perfect passive participle of βάλλω, "wounded" in `i` where a man is carried or spoken of |
| ὣς ἔφατ’ Εὐρύπυλος βεβλημένος (11.592) | "So spoke Eurypylus, struck" | "So spoke the wounded Eurypylus" | follows the table’s ὣς ἔφατ’ "So he spoke" rows |
| σάκε’ ὤμοισι κλίναντες (11.593) | "the shields on their shoulders leaning" | "resting their shields against their shoulders" | "tilting", "slanting"; κλίνω "lean" |
| δούρατ’ ἀνασχόμενοι (11.594) | "spears holding up" | "holding up their spears" | "raising", "bearing aloft"; ἀνέχω "hold up" |
| τῶν δ’ ἀντίος ἤλυθεν Αἴας (11.594) | "and opposite them came Ajax" | "and Ajax came to meet them" | "faced them", "advanced against"; follows the table’s ἀντίος ἦλθε "opposite came" / "came to meet" |
| δέμας πυρὸς αἰθομένοιο (11.596) | "in the likeness of blazing fire" | "like a blazing fire" | "in the form of", "burning fire" (the shipped "blazing fire"); δέμας "body, form" as an adverbial accusative |
| Νηλήϊαι ἵπποι (11.597) | "Neleian horses" | "the Neleian horses" | "horses of Neleus", "Neleus’ horses"; the adjective Νηλήϊος |
| ἱδρῶσαι (11.598) | "sweating" | "in a sweat" | "lathered", "drenched"; ἱδρόω "sweat" (the noun ἱδρώς "sweat" at 4.27) |
| ἐνόησε (τὸν δὲ ἰδὼν ἐνόησε, 11.599) | "noticed" | "took note of" | "recognised" (ἐνόησε is not "knew who"); follows the table’s ἐνόησεν "noticed" |
| ἐπὶ πρυμνῇ μεγακήτεϊ νηῒ (11.600) | "on the stern of the huge ship" | "on the stern of his huge ship" | "on the hindmost ship", "on the aft deck"; πρυμνή "stern", μεγακήτεϊ "huge" as the table’s (8.222) |
| πόνον αἰπύν (11.601) | "steep toil" | "steep toil" | "grievous toil", "sheer labour"; πόνος "toil", αἰπύς "steep" as in the table |
| ἰῶκα δακρυόεσσαν (11.601) | "the tearful rush" | "the tearful rush" | "rout", "pursuit", "war-cry", "onrush of battle" (each picks one guess); a rare word whose sense is not known, and the note says so; δακρυόεις "tearful" (5.737) |
| κακοῦ … ἀρχή (κακοῦ δ’ ἄρα οἱ πέλεν ἀρχή, 11.604) | "the beginning of evil it was" | "that was the beginning of evil for him" | "the source of ruin", "the start of his doom" (each turns ἀρχή into a cause); ἀρχή "beginning" as in the table’s ἀρχεκάκους "evil-beginning" |
| ἶσος Ἄρηϊ (11.604) | "equal to Ares" | "the equal of Ares" | "like Ares", "peer of Ares"; follows the table’s ἶσος Ἄρηϊ (11.295) "equal to … Ares" / "the equal of Ares" |
| τὸν πρότερος προσέειπε Μενοιτίου ἄλκιμος υἱός (11.605, whole-line speech introduction) | "Him first addressed Menoetius’ sturdy son:" | "Menoetius’ sturdy son spoke to him first:" | "valiant", "stout" (ἄλκιμος is "sturdy"); follows the table’s 5.276 row (πρότερος προσέειπε) |
| τίπτε … κικλήσκεις (11.606) | "why do you call me" | "why are you calling me" | "summon" (kept for κικλήσκω with a whole phrase), "name"; κικλήσκω "call", as in the shipped "summon" (iliad-052) for the literal act of summoning |
| τί δέ σε χρεὼ ἐμεῖο (11.606) | "and what need of me is upon you" | "what do you need me for" | "what do you want of me"; follows the table’s χρεώ "need" (9.607) |
| δῖε Μενοιτιάδη (vocative, 11.608) | "heavenly Menoetius’-son" | "heavenly son of Menoetius" | "noble", "godlike" (ἀντίθεος); the table’s δῖος "heavenly" and the patronymic as "Atreus’-son" / "son of Atreus" |
| νῦν ὀΐω … στήσεσθαι Ἀχαιοὺς λισσομένους (11.609) | "now I think that around my knees will stand the Achaeans, entreating" | "now I think the Achaeans will stand about my knees, entreating" | "I suspect" (the table’s 1.558 row, though the shipped iliad-001 to -003 give "I think" for this use), "I fear", "I imagine"; ὀΐω "I think" as in those parts; λίσσομαι "entreat" (2.14) |
| χρειὼ … ἱκάνεται οὐκέτ’ ἀνεκτός (11.610) | "need is coming, no longer bearable" | "a need is coming upon them that can no longer be borne" | "unbearable", "intolerable"; follows the table’s οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ἀνεκτά "no longer bearable" / "no longer to be borne" |
| Διῒ φίλε (vocative, 11.611) | "dear to Zeus" | "dear to Zeus" | "beloved of Zeus", "Zeus-loved"; follows the table’s Διῒ φίλος "dear to Zeus" |
| ἔρειο (11.611) | "ask" | "ask" | "enquire", "inquire of"; ἔρομαι "ask" |
| τά γ’ ὄπισθε … πάντα ἔοικε (11.613) | "in the parts behind, in all things he is like" | "from behind he looks in everything like" | "from the back", "in his gait", "in his build" (each decides what is seen); τά γ’ ὄπισθε "the parts behind" |
| Ἀσκληπιάδῃ (τῷ Ἀσκληπιάδῃ, 11.614) | "the Asclepius’-son" | "son of Asclepius" | "Asclepiades"; follows the table’s Ἀσκληπιάδη (4.204) "Asclepius’-son" / "son of Asclepius" |
| ὄμματα φωτός (11.614) | "the eyes of the man" | "the man’s eyes" | "face", "countenance" (each says more than the Greek); ὄμμα "eye" as the table’s ὄμματα (3.397) |
| παρήϊξαν πρόσσω μεμαυῖαι (11.615) | "rushed past me forward, eager" | "rushed past me, eager to go forward" | "darted past" (kept for ἀΐσσω), "sped"; follows the table’s παρήϊξεν "rushed past"; μεμαώς "eager" |
| βῆ δὲ θέειν (11.617) | "went to run" | "set off running" | "ran off", "hurried", "sped"; βῆ + infinitive is the epic way of starting an action |
| Νηληϊάδεω (11.618) | "Neleus’-son" | "Neleus’ son" | "Neleiades", "the son of Neleus"; the patronymic in -εω, as the table’s Ἀτρεΐδης "Atreus’-son" |
| ἀπέβησαν ἐπὶ χθόνα πουλυβότειραν (11.619) | "stepped down upon the much-nourishing earth" | "stepped down onto the earth that feeds so many" | follows iliad-019 (3.264) and the table’s πουλυβότειρα (8.378) |
| ἵππους … λύε … ἐξ ὀχέων (11.620–621) | "loosed … from the chariot" | "unyoked … from the chariot" | "unharnessed", "freed"; the plural ὄχεα is the one chariot, as in the table’s ὄχεα |
| τοὶ δ’ ἱδρῶ ἀπεψύχοντο (11.621) | "the sweat were cooling off from their tunics" | "cooled the sweat off their tunics" | "dried", "wiped off"; ἀποψύχω "cool off" |
| στάντε ποτὶ πνοιὴν παρὰ θῖν’ ἁλός (11.622) | "standing the two to the breeze, by the shore of the sea" | "stood facing the breeze by the shore of the sea" | "wind", "gale", "beach"; πνοιή "breeze", θίς "shore" |
| ἐπὶ κλισμοῖσι κάθιζον (11.623) | "upon seats they sat down" | "sat down on seats" | "chairs" (reserved for θρόνος), "couches"; κλισμός "seat" as the table’s |
| ἐϋπλόκαμος Ἑκαμήδη (11.624) | "fine-plaited Hecamede" | "fine-plaited Hecamede" | "fair-haired", "fair-tressed" (reserved for ἐυπλοκαμῖδες), "fine-haired"; the table’s ἐϋπλόκαμος "fine-plaited" |
| τεῦχε κυκειῶ (11.624) | "was making a stirred drink" | "was making a mixed drink" | "brewed", "was preparing a potion", "kykeon"; follows the table’s κυκεών "stirred drink" / "mixed drink" (10.290) |
| τὴν ἄρετ’ ἐκ Τενέδοιο γέρων (11.625) | "whom the old man won for himself from Tenedos" | "the woman the old man had won from Tenedos" | "took", "carried off", "chose" (kept for ἐξαιρέω); ἄρνυμαι "win for oneself" |
| ἔξελον … ἀριστεύεσκεν βουλῇ (11.626–627) | "chose out" · "he used to be the best in counsel" | "chose out for him" · "he used to be the best of all in counsel" | "picked", "selected"; "excelled in counsel" (the table’s ἀριστεύω "be the best", 6.208, 7.90, is kept, with the repeated form shown by "used to") |
| ἐπιπροΐηλε τράπεζαν (11.628) | "set out a table" | "set out a table" | "pushed up", "brought"; a rare compound taken as "set out before", and the note says so |
| κυανόπεζαν (τράπεζαν, 11.629) | "dark-footed" | "dark-footed" | "blue-footed", "with dark-blue legs" (κυανο- is "dark" as in the table’s κυανόπρῳρος "dark-prowed"); πέζα "foot" |
| χάλκειον κάνεον (11.630) | "a bronze basket" | "a bronze basket" | "brazen", "a copper tray"; χάλκειος "bronze" (the table’s), κάνεον "basket" (κάνεια "baskets", 10.355) |
| κρόμυον ποτῷ ὄψον (11.630) | "an onion, a relish for the drink" | "an onion, a relish for the drink" | "a snack", "a side dish", "meat" (the table’s ὄψον is "the dish eaten with bread"); κρόμυον "onion" |
| μέλι χλωρόν (11.631) | "yellow honey" | "yellow honey" | the table’s χλωρὸν μέλι "yellow honey" (10.234), unchanged |
| ἀλφίτου ἱεροῦ ἀκτήν (11.631) | "the meal of sacred barley" | "the meal of sacred barley" | "the grain of sacred barley-meal" (ἄλφιτον is already "barley-meal", and ἀκτή is ground grain), "the shore" (the other ἀκτή); "barley" for ἄλφιτον is a departure from the table’s ἄλφιτα "barley-meal", made so as not to say "meal" twice |
| δέπας περικαλλές (11.632) | "a very fair cup" | "a very fair cup" | "most beautiful cup", "goblet"; the table’s περικαλλής "very fair" and δέπας "cup" |
| χρυσείοις ἥλοισι πεπαρμένον (11.633) | "pierced through with golden studs" | "set with golden studs" | "golden nails", "studded with gold"; ἦλος "stud" as in the table’s ἀργυρόηλος "silver-studded", πείρω "pierce" |
| οὔατα (of a cup, 11.633) | "ears" | "handles" | "ears" in `i` (not English for a cup), "grips", "lugs"; the Greek word is "ears", and the note says it is the handles |
| δοιαὶ δὲ πελειάδες ἀμφὶς ἕκαστον χρύσειαι νεμέθοντο (11.634–635) | "two doves around each one, golden, were feeding" | "round each of them two golden doves were feeding" | "pecking", "grazing", "perched"; νεμέθομαι "feed", πέλεια "dove" (5.778), the count (two on each, or one on each side) left as in the Greek |
| δύω δ’ ὑπὸ πυθμένες ἦσαν (11.635) | "two bases beneath were" | "there were two bases beneath" | "two bottoms", "two stems", "two feet"; πυθμήν "base", how a cup has two left unexplained, as in the Greek |
| ἀποκινήσασκε … ἀμογητί (11.636–637) | "would move" · "without toil" | "would move it only with toil" · "without toil" | "would shift", "would budge" · "easily", "without effort"; μογέω "toil" keeps "toiling" in `l` and "toil" in `i`, ἀμογητί "without toil" |
| κύκησε (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε, 11.638) | "stirred" | "stirred a drink" | "mixed", "brewed"; κυκάω "stir", as the table’s ἐκύκα "stirred" (odyssey-047) |
| γυνὴ ἐϊκυῖα θεῇσιν (11.638) | "the woman, like goddesses" | "the woman, like goddesses" | "the woman, godlike", "like to the goddesses" (the Greek has no article); ἔοικα "be like" |
| αἴγειον … τυρόν · κνήστι χαλκείῃ (11.639–640) | "goat’s cheese" · "with a bronze grater" | "goat’s cheese" · "with a bronze grater" | "goat-milk cheese", "a copper rasp"; τυρός "cheese" as in odyssey-047, κνήστις "grater", χάλκειος "bronze" |
| ἄλφιτα λευκὰ πάλυνε (11.640) | "white barley-meal she sprinkled" | "sprinkled white barley-meal on top" | "scattered", "dusted"; the table’s ἄλφιτα λευκά "white barley-meal" (10.520) unchanged |
| πινέμεναι … ἐκέλευσεν (11.641) | "she ordered them to drink" | "she told them to drink" | "bade" (reserved for ἄνωγα), "urged"; follows the table’s κελεύω "ordered" (21.175) |
| ὥπλισσε κυκειῶ (11.641) | "made ready the stirred drink" | "made the drink ready" | "mixed", "prepared"; ὁπλίζω "make ready" |
| πολυκαγκέα δίψαν (11.642) | "much-parching thirst" | "parching thirst" | "great thirst", "dry thirst", "burning" (each guesses); a rare word, apparently "very parching", and the note says the formation is not secure |
| ἐφίστατο (θύρῃσιν ἐφίστατο, 11.644) | "stood at" | "came and stood at" | "appeared", "stopped"; ἐφίστημι "stand at" |
| ἐς δ’ ἄγε χειρὸς ἑλών (11.646) | "led him in, taking him by the hand" | "took him by the hand and led him in" | "seized his hand", "led him by the arm"; the genitive χειρός for the part taken |
| ἑδριάασθαι ἄνωγε (11.646) | "to sit down he bade him" | "bade him sit down" | "ordered", "urged"; follows the table’s ἄνωγα "bid" (reserved) |
| ἑτέρωθεν ἀναίνετο (11.647) | "from the other side, rejected it" | "on his side, rejected the offer" | "refused" (the table keeps "refuse" for ἀποείπῃ / ἀπεῖπον and gives ἀναίνομαι "reject", 9.510, 9.585, 9.679; the Odyssey’s "refused" at 3.265 is not followed), "turned away", "demurred"; the Greek has no object, and the offer of a seat is supplied in `i` |
| οὐχ ἕδος ἐστί (11.648) | "no seat is there" | "there is no sitting down" | "I will not sit", "no time to sit"; ἕδος "seat, sitting" |
| γεραιὲ διοτρεφές (vocative, 11.648, 11.653) | "aged one, Zeus-nurtured one" | "aged one, Zeus-nurtured one" | the table’s row for ἄττα … γεραιὲ διοτρεφές (9.607), unchanged; "old man" is kept for the noun ὁ γεραιός |
| αἰδοῖος νεμεσητός (11.649) | "revered, quick to take offence" | "a man to be revered, and quick to take offence" | "dreaded", "awesome", "formidable" (the table’s words for δεινός), "indignant"; αἰδοῖος "revered" (3.172), νεμεσητός read as "quick to take offence" and the note says the sense is disputed |
| ὁρόω (11.651) | "I see" | "I see" | "I perceive", "I recognise" (kept for γιγνώσκω); the uncontracted ὁρόω |
| ἔπος ἐρέων πάλιν ἄγγελος εἶμ’ (11.652) | "to tell the word, back as a messenger I shall go" | "I shall go back as his messenger, to tell him the word" | "to report", "bringing news"; ἐρέω "I shall say", ἄγγελος "messenger" (1.334, 2.26) |
| οἷος ἐκεῖνος δεινὸς ἀνήρ (11.653–654) | "what kind that one is, a dread man" | "what a man he is, a dread man" | "terrible", "fearsome" (αἰνός), "formidable"; δεινός keeps "dread" (1.200) |
| τάχα κεν καὶ ἀναίτιον αἰτιόῳτο (11.654) | "quickly he might even blame one blameless" | "he might very soon blame even the blameless" | "perhaps", "readily" for τάχα; follows odyssey-099 (ἀναίτιον αἰτιόῳο) "blameless" / "blame" |
